question: Network Affiliate collected $1,000 on June 12, 2025, for advertising shown at Rialto Theater, 250 East Broad Street, Westfield, NJ, which remained listed on Exhibit B. Network Affiliate refunded $100 and paid $40 in ordinary income tax, with no other refunds, similar disbursements, taxes or governmental charges. Does this transaction contribute $900 to Net Revenue?

Network Affiliate invoiced Maple Dental $2,400 on September 3, 2025, for advertising already shown at Cranford Theater, 25 North Avenue West, Cranford, NJ, which remained listed on Exhibit B. As of September 30, neither Network Affiliate nor anyone acting on its behalf had received any payment, credit, property or other consideration for the invoice. Does the unpaid $2,400 constitute Net Revenue as of September 30?

Cedar Beverages paid an agency for a lobby sampling event at Bloomfield 8, 863 Park Avenue, Bloomfield, CT, which remained listed on Exhibit B. The event was delivered as Lobby Promotions under the Agreement's Advertising Services. On October 10, 2025, the agency remitted Network Affiliate's $650 share. No advertising screen time was sold, and no refunds, similar disbursements, taxes or governmental charges applied to the $650. Is the $650 Net Revenue?

On November 4, 2025, Network Affiliate collected $800 for a hardware store's printed advertisement displayed only at Harbor Cinema in Portland, Maine. Harbor Cinema was expressly designated an Excluded Theatre, and that designation remained in effect. The sale and display were entirely outside the Service and had no connection to alternative or independent digital film distribution. With no refunds or deductions, is this $800 Net Revenue?

A worksheet headed 'Net Revenue review' lists a Rialto Theater advertising invoice for $720 and a Cranford Theater advertising invoice for $680. Is the listed Rialto invoice amount greater than the listed Cranford invoice amount?

An email titled 'Net Revenue documentation' records that Bloomfield 8's lobby promotion receipt was sent to accounting on March 18, 2025, and states a submission deadline of March 17, 2025. Was the receipt sent on or before the stated deadline?

Converge's May 12, 2025 email to VNE concerns Atlas, a Deployed Product under the Subscription License Agreement that is not the Structured Negotiations Product. The first paragraph describes a transaction failure meeting Exhibit A's Severity Level 2 description and labels it Severity Level 2. The second paragraph independently asks for instructions for changing the display language using an existing, correctly functioning setting, without reporting a malfunction or requesting a modification. Is the second paragraph to be treated as a Support Request?

On June 3, 2025, Converge submits a ticket to VNE consisting solely of a description of an order-submission outage in Beacon and an explicit Severity Level 1 designation. Beacon is a Deployed Product under the Subscription License Agreement and is not the Structured Negotiations Product, and the outage meets Exhibit A's description of a Severity Level 1 problem. With no separate question or other content in the ticket, is this ticket a Support Request?

VNE developed a new supplier-dashboard widget for Meridian at Converge's specific request as part of the Professional Services under this agreement. Meridian is a Deployed Product under the Subscription License Agreement. On July 9, 2025, Converge sends VNE a message solely requesting delivery of that widget as a modification to Meridian, without reporting any malfunction. Is this message a Support Request?

An August 2025 billing worksheet headed 'Support Request review' lists ticket SR-418 about export instructions for a supplier ledger with an estimated charge of $90 and a final listed charge of $75. Is the final listed charge $15 lower than the estimated charge?

A routing log headed 'Support Request intake' records that Converge sent ticket SR-562 about a purchasing application's login screen on September 16, 2025, and that VNE acknowledged the ticket on September 18, 2025. Does the log show VNE acknowledging the ticket before Converge sent it?
Atelier Lumiere plans to sell licensed scarves solely from a permanent street-level shop in Lyon, France. Is that proposed sales location within the Agreement's Territory?

Mar Azul Retail proposes selling licensed watches aboard the cruise ship Aurora Vale. The ship's sole base port is Lisbon, Portugal, and every voyage starts and ends there, visiting only Portuguese ports. Is the onboard sales location within the Agreement's Territory?
Coral House proposes displaying and selling licensed ceramics only in its permanent gift shop in Bridgetown, Barbados, in the Caribbean. Is that shop within the Agreement's Territory?

The cruise ship Silver Meridian is based solely at the Port of Miami in Florida, United States of America. Meridian Gifts proposes selling licensed handbags aboard the ship during a two-day call in Marseille, France; Miami remains the ship's sole base port. Is that onboard sales location within the Agreement's Territory?
A procurement worksheet headed 'Territory review' lists a ceramic display bowl at $48 and a wooden display tray at $35. Is the listed bowl price higher than the listed tray price?

An email titled 'Territory review: silk scarf display' was sent by Elena Ortiz to Marcus Chen on 14 April 2025 and records delivery of the display on 11 April 2025. Was the email sent before the recorded delivery date?

On April 8, 2024, Harbor Analytical LLC, a separately incorporated laboratory that is neither Magenta Therapeutics, Inc. nor Bachem Americas, Inc., accepted a purchase order to test a peptide sample for Magenta. Is Harbor Analytical LLC a Third Party under the Agreement?

On June 17, 2024, Cedar Biologistics, Inc. arranged refrigerated shipment of a manufacturing batch. Cedar is a wholly owned subsidiary of Bachem Americas, Inc., but is a separately incorporated legal entity, not Bachem Americas, Inc. or Magenta Therapeutics, Inc. Is Cedar Biologistics, Inc. a Third Party under the Agreement?

On September 9, 2024, Magenta Therapeutics, Inc., the corporation identified as Magenta in the Agreement, purchased a reference standard for use in a development study. The purchaser on the invoice was Magenta Therapeutics, Inc. itself. Is that purchaser a Third Party under the Agreement?

On November 12, 2024, Bachem Americas, Inc., the corporation identified as Bachem in the Agreement, issued a batch-release certificate through its internal Quality Operations department. Quality Operations is a department of that corporation, not a separately incorporated company; Bachem Americas, Inc. is the certificate's legal issuer. Is the certificate's legal issuer a Third Party under the Agreement?

A procurement log headed 'Third Party laboratory review' lists a quote from Atlas Testing LLC for peptide purity testing at $840 and a quote from Beacon Analytics LLC for the same testing at $960. Is Atlas Testing LLC's quoted price lower than Beacon Analytics LLC's quoted price?

A file titled 'Third Party courier assessment' records that North Pier Logistics LLC collected a sample cooler on March 14, 2024, and delivered the cooler on March 16, 2024. Did collection and delivery occur on the same calendar date?

On April 8, 2025, a Japanese prefectural government pharmaceutical bureau issued Sakura Cold Storage Ltd. a warehouse storage license. The bureau's review and license are legally required before Fintepla may be stored at that warehouse in Japan. The license does not set or list a reimbursement price. Does this storage license qualify as a Regulatory Approval under the contract?

On June 12, 2025, PMDA issued Aoba Pharma an authorization legally required to import a shipment of pharmaceutical tablets containing a salt of fenfluramine into Japan. Without this authorization, the shipment cannot lawfully enter Japan. The document concerns importation only and contains no national health insurance price listing. Is this authorization a Regulatory Approval under the contract?

Koyo Logistics' Regulatory Approval tracking register records a Fintepla import authorization file as received on February 10, 2025, and its courier invoice as paid on February 13, 2025. Was the file received before the invoice was paid?

Nara Biologics' Regulatory Approval budget worksheet lists translation of a Fintepla warehouse license at ¥48,000 and delivery of the translated license at ¥6,000. Is the listed delivery charge greater than the listed translation charge?

On June 12, 2025, Health Canada, the Canadian governmental agency empowered to grant pharmaceutical marketing authorizations, issued SIGA an authorization permitting marketing and sale in Canada of the FDA-approved oral TPOXX formulation for use in the contract's Field. Canada is not a Discontinued Country, and the authorization does not establish prices or reimbursement amounts. Does this authorization qualify as Regulatory Approval under the contract?

On September 9, 2025, New Zealand's governmental medicines authority, legally empowered to authorize pharmaceutical marketing and sale there, granted Drug Approval to SIGA for a new oral formulation of tecovirimat for use in the contract's Field. The same instrument permits marketing and sale in New Zealand, makes no pricing or reimbursement determination, and concerns a formulation without FDA approval. New Zealand is not a Discontinued Country. Does this instrument qualify as Regulatory Approval under the contract?

On February 18, 2025, the French governmental body legally responsible for pharmaceutical reimbursement set the reimbursable amount for the FDA-approved oral TPOXX formulation used in the contract's Field at EUR 420 per pack. France is not a Discontinued Country. This decision grants no permission to market or sell; a separate, earlier authorization governs marketing and sale. Does the February 18 reimbursement decision itself qualify as Regulatory Approval under the contract?

On November 4, 2025, South Korea's governmental medicines authority, legally empowered to grant pharmaceutical marketing authorizations there, permitted marketing and sale in South Korea of the FDA-approved oral TPOXX formulation for use in the contract's Field. The authorization concerns South Korea alone and makes no pricing or reimbursement determination. Does this authorization qualify as Regulatory Approval under the contract?

A SIGA records register headed 'Regulatory Approval correspondence' lists a Canadian oral TPOXX authorization packet as received on May 14, 2025, and a French TPOXX reimbursement packet as received on May 16, 2025. Was the Canadian packet recorded as received before the French packet?

An invoice labeled 'Regulatory Approval document translations' charges USD 680 to translate an oral TPOXX marketing authorization and USD 740 to translate a TPOXX price determination. These amounts are translation service charges, not pharmaceutical prices. Is the listed translation charge for the marketing authorization greater than the listed translation charge for the price determination?

On May 8, 2013, Bloom Energy Corporation, acting as Operator, delivered to Diamond State Generation Partners, LLC, as Owner, a laminated diagram giving step-by-step instructions for inspecting and replacing seals in the water supply equipment installed by BE for the Facility on the parcel leased under the February 10, 2012 DPL Site Lease. The diagram is an instructional sheet, not a data file or report. Does the diagram qualify as Training Materials under the Agreement?

On September 19, 2014, Bloom Energy Corporation, as Operator, delivered to Diamond State Generation Partners, LLC, as Owner, a revised maintenance notebook for the Agreement's Bloom Systems installed on the DDOT-leased Site. The notebook replaces an earlier valve-cleaning procedure with corrected illustrated instructions and a safer maintenance sequence; it contains instructions only, with no operating data or reports. Does the revised notebook qualify as Training Materials under the Agreement?

On November 6, 2015, Bloom Energy Corporation, as Operator, delivered to Diamond State Generation Partners, LLC, as Owner, the October Maintenance Report for the Agreement's Bloom Systems at the DPL-leased Site. This monthly report records inspections, measured temperatures and completed repairs and includes a section explaining how to clean the units' air filters. There is no separate instructional attachment. Does the report as a whole qualify as Training Materials under the Agreement?

On January 22, 2016, Bloom Energy Corporation, as Operator, delivered to Diamond State Generation Partners, LLC, as Owner, a printed service manual explaining toner replacement and paper-feed maintenance for a freestanding photocopier at Owner's Wilmington administrative office. Neither the office nor the photocopier is at either Agreement Site, the photocopier is not installed in connection with any Facility, and the manual contains no instructions concerning Bloom Systems or equipment at either Site. The manual is not a report or data set. Does this manual qualify as Training Materials under the Agreement?

A March 4, 2016 purchasing record headed Training Materials lists a printed Bloom System maintenance binder at $48 and a laminated inspection card at $12, both before tax. Is the binder's listed price greater than the card's listed price?

A shipping log headed Training Materials records dispatch of a crate containing a Bloom System maintenance demonstration model on June 14, 2017 and receipt on June 16, 2017. Was the crate received on the same calendar date that it was dispatched?

Harbor Grid scheduled delivery of a replacement transformer for Tuesday, July 14, 2026, which is not a banking holiday. The applicable Tariff incorporates the agreement's express Business Day definition without alteration. Does the scheduled delivery date qualify as a Business Day?

Cedar Energy received a meter-testing report on Monday, November 16, 2026. The date is not a banking holiday, although Cedar Energy's office was closed for its annual staff retreat. The applicable Tariff incorporates the agreement's express Business Day definition without alteration. Does November 16 qualify as a Business Day?

Northbank Utilities arranged a cable inspection for Saturday, July 18, 2026. The date is not a banking holiday, and both the inspection crew and the customer-service desk were operating that day. The applicable Tariff incorporates the agreement's express Business Day definition without alteration. Does the inspection date qualify as a Business Day?

Summit Transmission scheduled an automated invoice transmission for Friday, December 25, 2026. That date is a banking holiday under the banking calendar applicable to the agreement, and Summit's automated billing system operates every day. The applicable Tariff incorporates the agreement's express Business Day definition without alteration. Does the scheduled transmission date qualify as a Business Day?

A Bayview Power invoice lists a replacement relay at $480 and a delivery charge at $35, with the note 'Payment due on the next Business Day.' Is the listed relay price greater than the listed delivery charge?

An Eastfield Electric dispatch record lists six voltage sensors in crate A and nine voltage sensors in crate B and instructs the warehouse to ship both crates on the next Business Day. Does crate A contain more voltage sensors than crate B?

On April 12, 2025, a fire destroyed the kitchen at franchisee Maple Street Dining LLC's restaurant. Maple Street Dining submits the fire itself for review, not an inability to obtain financing or make payments. Does the kitchen fire fall within "Force Majeure" under the Agreement?

On September 8, 2025, the City of Fairhaven ordered franchisee Harbor Coffee LLC to close its outdoor seating area for ten days during municipal water-main replacement. The event presented for classification is the city's closure order, not an inability to finance operations or make payments. Does that order fall within "Force Majeure" under the Agreement?

Franchisee Cedar Bakery LLC sought a $90,000 equipment loan. Its bank rejected the application on February 20, 2025, because its credit score was below the bank's lending threshold, and no other lender would provide financing. Does Cedar Bakery's inability to obtain that financing constitute "Force Majeure" under the Agreement?

A government order froze franchisee Brookside Meals LLC's bank accounts on June 3, 2025. With no other available funds, Brookside Meals could not make its June 5, 2025 royalty payment. Considering the inability to make that payment rather than the freeze order itself, does Brookside Meals's inability to pay constitute "Force Majeure" under the Agreement?

A claims log headed "Force Majeure review" records damage to a restaurant's walk-in freezer and lists a repair estimate of $4,800 and a replacement estimate of $7,100. Is the listed repair estimate lower than the listed replacement estimate?
An email titled "Force Majeure: damaged delivery van," attaching photographs of the van, was sent by Rosa Chen to Malik Grant on October 14, 2025. Was Malik Grant the sender of that email?

FG's May 12, 2005 license with independent company Harbor Synthesis Ltd. remained in effect on June 1, 2005. It immediately granted FG rights to use Harbor's patented purification process to manufacture FG-2216 under the collaboration, rather than an option to obtain those rights. Does this license qualify as a Third Party Agreement?

An FG register headed 'Third Party Agreements review' lists a proposed FG-2216 assay license from Aspen BioTools at an upfront fee of $42,000 and a review budget of $50,000. Is the quoted upfront fee lower than the listed review budget?

Nora Chen sent Daniel Ruiz an email titled 'Third Party Agreements: FG-2216 manufacturing license' on October 11, 2005. Its attached invitation scheduled the license-review meeting for October 14, 2005. Was the scheduled meeting date earlier than the email's sending date?

On March 12, 2025, Alder Cartography Ltd. listed its registered copyright in an original illustrated hiking atlas in an asset schedule. The listed asset is the copyright in the atlas artwork, not a name, logo, or other designation of source. Does that asset fall within "Copyrights" under the supplied contract definition?

Mara Chen owns an unregistered copyright in an original cello composition titled Evening Rain and filed an application to register that copyright on April 8, 2025. A proposed purchase schedule lists the pending copyright application as a separate asset. Neither the composition nor the application is used or filed as a designation of commercial source. Does the pending application fall within "Copyrights" under the supplied contract definition?

On June 3, 2025, Harbor Lantern Cleaning LLC filed a service-mark application for the words HARBOR LANTERN to identify its cleaning services. An acquisition schedule lists only that service-mark application, not any copyright or copyright application. Does the listed application fall within "Copyrights" under the supplied contract definition?

Sable Orchard Foods sells jam in a distinctive fluted jar with a copper-colored lid that customers recognize as identifying Sable Orchard as the producer. In a September 19, 2025 transaction, the asset being evaluated is solely Sable Orchard's unregistered trade-dress rights in that packaging, with no copyright in artwork or other material included. Does that asset fall within "Copyrights" under the supplied contract definition?

A valuation worksheet headed "Copyrights" lists the illustrated cookbook Hearth Table at $4,800 and the photograph collection Winter Piers at $3,200. Is the listed amount for Hearth Table greater than the listed amount for Winter Piers?

An email with the subject "Copyrights: warehouse mural file" was sent by Elena Ruiz to Marcus Bell on November 6, 2025, with a digital image of the warehouse mural attached. Was Marcus Bell the sender of that email?

Harbor Payment Services scheduled a merchant settlement for June 14, 2025, a Saturday that was not a holiday recognized by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Under the contract, was June 14, 2025 a Processing Day?

Cedar Equipment Finance scheduled an account reconciliation for January 20, 2025. That date was a Monday and Martin Luther King Day, a holiday recognized by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Under the contract, was January 20, 2025 a Processing Day?

Briar Wholesale scheduled a supplier payment for November 27, 2025. That date was a Thursday and Thanksgiving Day, a holiday recognized by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Under the contract, was November 27, 2025 a Processing Day?

Maple Ledger Systems scheduled a receipt batch for June 15, 2025, a Sunday that was not a holiday recognized by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York. Under the contract, was June 15, 2025 a Processing Day?

An Alder Bank operations report titled 'Processing Day Settlement Queue' lists batch Q-17 with 48 payment instructions and batch Q-18 with 35 payment instructions. Does the report list more payment instructions for Q-17 than for Q-18?

North Quay Treasury received an email titled 'Processing Day transfer schedule' concerning transfer T-604. The email record identifies Elena Park as the sender and Marcus Bell as the recipient. Does the record identify Marcus Bell as the sender?

Aster Pulmonary is developing AP-17, a corticosteroid delivered by inhaler. A completed clinical trial in adults demonstrated that AP-17 has a duration of action of exactly 24 hours. Does AP-17 qualify as ICS under the contract?

Meridian Therapeutics' MT-42 is a corticosteroid formulated as an oral tablet, and clinical testing in patients demonstrated a duration of action of 30 hours. MT-42 is not administered by inhalation. Does MT-42 qualify as ICS under the contract?

Cedar Respiratory's CR-8 is an inhaled corticosteroid. Clinical testing established a duration of action of 23 hours, with its action ending at that point, although the recommended dosing interval is once every 24 hours. Does CR-8 qualify as ICS under the contract?

Northbank Biologics' NB-61 is an inhaled corticosteroid whose duration of action was demonstrated to be 36 hours in animal studies. As of June 10, 2025, NB-61 has never undergone clinical testing, and all testing has been laboratory or animal work. Does NB-61 qualify as ICS under the contract as of that date?

An invoice headed 'ICS evaluation supplies' lists a carton of PX-14 inhaler cartridges at $180 and a spacer kit at $45. Is the listed price of the carton greater than the listed price of the spacer kit?

A logistics record titled 'ICS candidate shipment' states that a package containing QL-9 inhaler samples was dispatched on September 12, 2025, and delivered on September 15, 2025. Was the package delivered on the same calendar date it was dispatched?

A filling machine at Brookvale Therapeutics failed on July 7, 2026, halting manufacturing required under the Agreement for three weeks. Its bearing was six months overdue for mandatory replacement, and Brookvale's maintenance manager had postponed replacement despite repeated wear alarms to avoid a planned one-day shutdown. Timely replacement would have prevented the failure and was routine diligence reasonably and ordinarily expected of a skilled and experienced operator of the same equipment. No payment obligation was affected. Does the machine failure qualify as Force Majeure?

A Force Majeure review file for a damaged refrigerated shipping container contains quotations dated February 9, 2026: Polar Service quoted $8,400 and Coldline Repair quoted $9,100. Was Polar Service's quoted price lower than Coldline Repair's?

A Force Majeure incident log for Seabrook Laboratories' failed sterilizer records the failure on April 16, 2026, and the sending of Seabrook's incident notice to its contracting partner on April 19, 2026. Did Seabrook send the notice before the recorded failure date?

On April 8, 2025, Larch Robotics delivered to contract counterparty Meridian Assembly a file marked "Confidential" containing proprietary, nonpublic motor-calibration specifications. Meridian had never possessed or developed those specifications and received them only from Larch. The specifications remain nonpublic, and no law requires disclosure. Does the agreement's obligation not to divulge Confidential Information prohibit Meridian from sending the file to its wholly owned subsidiary for a bid on an unrelated project?

Vale Chemicals gave contract counterparty Harbor Process a proprietary, nonpublic catalyst formula in a writing marked "Confidential" on June 3, 2025. Harbor had neither previously possessed nor independently developed the formula and had no other source for it. Harbor then deliberately published the formula on a public website on June 10 without Vale's permission. No law requires disclosure. On June 12, does the agreement's obligation not to divulge Confidential Information still prohibit Harbor from emailing the formula to a customer?

Rowan Analytics orally disclosed a proprietary, nonpublic customer-pricing strategy to contract counterparty Crest Distribution on September 1, 2025. Crest had never possessed or developed it and received it from no other source. Rowan first submitted a written summary identifying the strategy on October 6, 2025, with no earlier written summary submitted. The strategy remains nonpublic, and no law compels disclosure. Does the agreement's obligation not to divulge Confidential Information apply to Crest's planned description of that strategy to an outside consultant on October 10?

On February 14, 2025, Northstar Instruments gave contract counterparty Elm Engineering a nonpublic technical drawing marked "Confidential" showing a pressure-valve geometry. Elm's November 20, 2024 laboratory notebook and archived CAD file establish prior possession of the identical geometry through Elm's own work before any contact with Northstar and without reference to Northstar information. Elm received no Northstar-derived material through anyone else. The geometry remains nonpublic, and no law requires disclosure. Does the agreement's obligation not to divulge Confidential Information prohibit Elm from sending its November CAD file showing that geometry to a machining vendor?

Aster Legal's inventory headed "Confidential Information review" lists a prototype sensor drawing with 12 pages and a cost spreadsheet with 8 pages. Does the drawing have four more pages than the spreadsheet?

A Briar Manufacturing dispatch log headed "Confidential Information deliveries" records a sealed tooling blueprint sent by Lina Perez on March 18, 2025, and a sealed pricing workbook sent by Omar Chen on March 19, 2025. Was the tooling blueprint sent later than the pricing workbook?
